test_policy.notes: Penn State first-year applicants may choose whether to self-report SAT/ACT scores through MyPennState; no superscoring and ACT Science is not accepted. The Altoona Common Data Set agrees: not required, considered if submitted.

requirements.notes: Penn State application fee is $75 for international applicants ($65 domestic). Application is the same for all Penn State campuses; altoona.psu.edu returned HTTP 403 to automated access, so deadlines, English minimums and fee are the university-wide Undergraduate Admissions rules and should be confirmed with Penn State Altoona (altoonaadmission@psu.edu). Altoona Common Data Set: GPA very important, rigor important; essay, recommendations, interview not considered.

deadlines.label: Early Action (university-wide)
deadlines.notes: Apply by Nov 1 to receive a decision by Dec 24. The Altoona Common Data Set lists the same Nov 1 closing and Dec 24 notification dates.

deadlines.label: Recommended submission deadline for all applications
deadlines.notes: Dec 1 is a recommended date, not a hard closing date: the Altoona Common Data Set reports no application closing date and admission is rolling. No regular-decision notification date is published on the page.

english_policy.waiver_notes: University-wide rule. Required of international applicants whose native language is not English (US citizens and permanent residents are exempt). Alternatives: SAT EBRW 570+ (code 2660), ACT English 24+ (code 3656), GCSE/GCE English language A-C, IB English A 5+, four years at a US high school, or certification from Penn State's Intensive English Communication Program (IECP). Test scores must be under two years old; TOEFL MyBest is not accepted.

aid.notes: Penn State states there is essentially no financial aid available for international undergraduate students, and the Altoona Common Data Set reports no institutional aid for nonresidents.

tier_notes.general: Our estimate: Penn State branch campus whose degrees carry the Penn State name; the enrolled-student academic profile (average GPA 3.24, SAT middle 50% 1120-1290 among submitters) is above typical open-access campuses. Subject tiers are D because the campus is small.
